mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the current month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discounting of future cash flows.
regime_hint: FED Funds rate above 4% in tightening phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 4.0 months.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 2% from the prior month, labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth, yielding a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS momentum (Pearson < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 3% predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand reduces near-term earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite the identified demand contraction (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 104 (current month) after being above 105 for the prior three months, it signals supply-side weakness that precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 104 and INDPRO > 105 for t-3, t-2, t-1
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in all such transition periods (empirical frequency > 70%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE above 4% and 5% respectively for the next three months creates a dual inflation+tightening effect that predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND UNRATE > 5.0 for next 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the combined signal (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 480,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, it reflects resilient consumer demand and supports a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.1) during qualifying RSAFS periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in GDPC1 (GDP) of at least 2% over the next quarter is associated with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak aggregate demand depresses earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite the GDP contraction (empirical frequency < 30%).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (CPI) exceeds 245 for three consecutive months, it indicates persistent inflation pressure that is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return via investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with CPIAUCSL inflation (Pearson > 0.2).
